payload.title: File:Lethenia carranzaensis holotype.png
payload.description_html: Lethenia carranzaensis sp. nov. (SGO.PV.6635, holotype). Preserved teeth. (A) Anterior tooth in labial view. (B) Same in lingual view. (C) Profile view. (D) Incomplete anterior tooth. (E) Anterolateral tooth in labial view. (F) Same in lingual view. (G) Anterior tooth in labial view. (H) Anterolateral tooth in labial view. (I) Posterolateral tooth in labial view. (J) Anterior tooth in labial view. (K, L, M) Different posterolateral teeth. (N) Symphyseal fragment of the Meckel’s cartilage (left ramus). (O) Posterior fragments of palatoquadrate and Meckel’s cartilage (both left rami) in relative occlusion. (P) Associated vertebra in articular view. (Q) Same in lateral view. Scale bars equals 10 mm, except N–Q, 50 mm.
